title: Sheafification preserves ordinary pro-etale geometric stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of abelian groups on the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ be its abelian sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Index both colimits below over the opposite of the category of pointed weakly etale neighbourhoods $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar x$ defined in [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then the canonical homomorphism $\varinjlim_{(V,\bar v)}\mathcal P(V)\xrightarrow{\varinjlim\theta_V}\varinjlim_{(V,\bar v)}\mathcal P^\#(V)$ is an isomorphism, natural in $\mathcal P$.

proof.text: For a covering sieve of V and v : Spec Ω → V, use ProEt.mem_topology_iff to choose a covering presieve and present it as a family. Apply Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback to base change this family to Spec Ω. The underlying jointly surjective weakly etale family has a nonempty member. The fully proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.exists_comp_eq_id_of_weaklyEtale gives a section of that member over the algebraically closed field Ω. Compose with the other pullback projection to get a lift of exactly v to an original member. This is the private proved helper lift_geometricPoint_cover; no new algebraic closure or arbitrary witness is defined.

proof.text: Let p be proEtaleGeometricNeighbourhoodForget x. Given a covering sieve R and f : p(U) → Y, apply the lift helper to the covering pullback of R along f and the lift of U. The resulting pointed neighbourhood V and arrow q : V → U satisfy the lifting condition hp for Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.Point.ofIsCofiltered. Use the existing cofilteredness and initial smallness instances of the neighbourhood category, and construct Φ in universe u+1.

source.place: Tag 0F6B and the paragraph before Tag 0993; Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.OfIsCofiltered

proof.text: For any abelian presheaf F, Mathlib Point.isColimitPresheafFiberOfIsCofilteredCocone gives the Φ-fiber as a colimit of p.op ⋙ F. Let e_F identify the chosen colimit with this fiber. Prove the coprojection equation he and its inverse hei. By colimit.hom_ext and Point.toPresheafFiberOfIsCofiltered_naturality, the map induced by a : F → G is e_F.hom followed by Φ.presheafFiber.map a followed by e_G.inv. The generic Mathlib Point sheafification instance makes the middle map an isomorphism for a = toSheafify, so the required colimit map is an isomorphism.

For a : P → Q, combine both pairs of colimit maps using colim.map_comp, combine whiskered transformations using Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, and apply toSheafify_naturality. This proves the naturality equality exactly as stated.
